Senses.Explanation: A fixed list-name for the shining host of the sky, traveling with the rivers and grounds below. Yunmen Wenyan asks what they call the rivers and grounds, the luminaries, and the four elements, then calls his own words a village wife's talk fit to be dragged off the steps, Foyan Qingyuan reads the linked pearls of the luminaries at the imperial anniversary as the fruit of the sovereign's virtue and comes down from the seat to dance his ten thousand years, Chijue Daochong hangs the luminaries with the rivers, the myriad forms, and color and emptiness on the three turns of his senior fellow, Hengchuan Rugong calls the rivers and grounds waves of the boundless nature sea, the luminaries waves, and the noses of all buddhas soaked soft in it, and Chushi Fanqi sings the ground tilted northwest with the luminaries tied to a sky that never lowers, while every nose stays straight and every eye level. Wuyi Yuanlai takes the sky as mouth, the sea as tongue, the luminaries as adornment, and the rivers as audience, and still no one hears, Yi'an Shanzan rules the rivers and the luminaries what the wondrous bright true nature shows, with no fault to find, Muchen Daomin lets all be Maitreya and sends the rivers and the luminaries back to being themselves, Yuan'an Liao plows under even the earth, the sky, the luminaries, and the grass and trees till nothing above can shelter and nothing below can block, and Guantao Daqi casts the whole ten directions as one furnace into which the luminaries and all that flies and burrows enter and melt into one body.
